name: Aksum
description: Aksum is a town in northern Ethiopia, set at the foot of the Adwa mountains near the Eritrean border. It was once the capital of a kingdom that rivalled Rome and Persia in power. Visitors can walk among towering carved stone obelisks, giant stelae, royal tombs and ruined palaces, and Ethiopian emperors were still being crowned here centuries after the kingdom declined.
